why.title: Why Sommen?
why.intro: Sommen is one of the clearest and most beautiful lakes in southern Sweden — ideal for a quiet nature holiday.

points.title: Crystal-clear water
points.text: Bathe, fish and swim in one of the cleanest lakes in the region.

points.title: Over 350 islands
points.text: A branching lake system to explore by boat or kayak.

points.title: Peace and nature
points.text: Vast forests, wildlife and stillness — far from everyday life.

points.title: Fishing & activities
points.text: Pike, perch and whitefish; plus hiking and cycling around the lake.

cabinDescriptions.seeblick: Cozy holiday home right on the shore of Sommen. Set off from your own jetty by boat or kayak, and warm up in the sauna in the evening. Ideal for families who love water and nature.
cabinDescriptions.waldhuette: Quietly located cabin at the edge of the forest, a few minutes from the lake. Explore the surroundings by bike; pets are warmly welcome.
cabinDescriptions.sommenblick: Spacious house with panoramic views over Sommen. Room for up to six people, its own boat, sauna and terrace — perfect for larger groups.
